CustomObject.description: Pricing table for Cabinet product Draw Capacity (kVA) tiers. Each record maps a kVA tier to its monthly price in SGD and HKD. Used by QuoteLineItemAttributeHandler to adjust QuoteLineItem.UnitPrice when a kVA attribute is selected. Populate with real pricing data from DE APAC rate card before go-live.
